def _cw_json_safe(value):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):

    _dtype = getattr(value, 'dtype', None)
    if _shape is not None and _dtype is not None:
        try:
            return {
                'type': 'ndarray',
                'shape': list(_shape),
                'dtype': str(_dtype),
            }
        except Exception:
            pass
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _cw_json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_cw_json_safe(item) for item in value]
    return repr(value)
